handback.summary: Code now checks the reviewer's six boxes at both review stages, naming each fault.

criteria.819.1: `problems_boxes` in `dokima/agent_checks.py` names each box left out, or boxes when all are gone.
criteria.819.2: `problems_boxes` names the box and field of a partial entry, a wrong added kind, a bare line.
criteria.819.3: `poor_tests` entries need `passes_with` filled; blank or missing is rejected naming it.
criteria.819.4: An approve with any blocking entry, or an edges line reading missing, is rejected naming that box.
criteria.819.5: Added entries of kind needed are not counted as blocking, so an approve passes.
criteria.819.6: `problems_edges` names each plan criterion with no edges line; none only passes with no criteria.
